print_errors.note: In the bold title the name is printed with dotless final ى in يسرى and رشدى. The body text and the running head print يسري رشدي with dots. Kept as printed, as CONVENTIONS §2 also notes.
Printed «١٩٩٧م .» with a visible space before the final period. Normalized to no space per CONVENTIONS §2 spacing, as in earlier batches.
Printed «حفظ القرآن الكريم :» with a space before the colon. Normalized to no space, matching the STRUCTURE list and the b02 precedent «قائلا:».
Printed with no space after the period. Kept glued as printed.
The second occurrence is printed with final ه instead of ة in both words; the first occurrence on the same page has «بالمدينة المنورة». Kept as printed. Checked at 450 dpi.
Printed with dotless final ى (the body font draws its automatic small alif over it). p.034 prints the same name «بدوي» with dots. Kept as printed.

Printed «رحمه الله .كما»: the space sits before the period and the period touches «كما». The space before the period was dropped per §2 spacing. No space was added after it, as none is printed. An arbiter may prefer «رحمه الله. كما».
The و ends one printed line and النظائر begins the next. A line can only break at a space, so the space is kept: «و النظائر».

notes: Markers: p.032 ends a complete section («…ونعم الوكيل.») and has no footnotes, so p.033 starts a new section with no '+' and no (تابع). p.034 begins with the ### title «حفظ القرآن الكريم» (no '+'). p.034 ends mid-sentence «…عن عاصم، وكان», so it is followed by <<<ص:035+>>>. p.035 ends mid-name «…سيدي عبد الله», so it is followed by <<<ص:036+>>>. p.036 ends mid-sentence «…إجازة عامة». No footnotes, glosses, Quran, bold runs or honorific glyphs in this batch. «رضي الله عنهم/عنهما», «صلى الله عليه وسلم», «عليه السلام» and «رحمه الله» are printed as ordinary words. p.033: the calligraphic line «الفقير إلى الله» is a plain paragraph before the # heading, per STRUCTURE. Its small alif over ى and the drawn shadda on الله are font-automatic, so it is written plain. The abbreviation dot in «أ.د/» is drawn at mid-height in the bold title font. It is written ASCII '.', as in STRUCTURE and b01. The date «٢٣ / ٩ / ١٩٥٤م» is printed with spaces around both slashes. «٢٥محرم» is printed glued: the ink gap is 25 px at 900 dpi, against 45 px between the digits ٥ and ٢ and 72 px or more for word spaces. «١٣٧٤ هـ» has a space before هـ, and هـ keeps its tatweel. «المولد والنشأة:» is ###. p.034: the two prose dashes («وزر بن حبيش – الأول», «رضي الله عنهما – وهم») are en dashes with spaces, written U+2013 as in earlier batches. «حفظا» has no tanween. «عبد الله», «عبد الرحمن», «عبد الحكيم» and «عبد السلام» are printed with a space. p.035: «العلماء والمشايخ حفظهم ورحمهم الله:» is ###. The paragraphs «…ثم انتقل إلى رحمة الله» and (p.036) «…فجزاه الله خيرا ورحمه الله» have no final period in print. p.036: the date dash «١٤٠٠هـ – ١٩٨٠ م» is between numbers, so it is written as an ASCII hyphen with the printed spaces: «١٤٠٠هـ - ١٩٨٠ م». The second date is read right to left as ١٢ / ٢ / ١٩٩٣. Closest ink gaps at 900 dpi: ١٢|/ = 91 px, /|٢ = 129 px, ٢|/ = 31 px and /|١٩٩٣ = 81 px, against 35-63 px between digits. So it is written «١٤١٣ هـ ١٢ / ٢/ ١٩٩٣». «د: علي جمعة» has the colon as printed. The body font's automatic small alif over final ى (على، إلى، حتى، تولى، وتعالى، صلى) is written as plain ى. Zooms are saved as scratch\kA09_*.
